title: Premier — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Premier.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Classic Cooking." Value tier. Premier makes basic gas and electric ranges in Reading, Pennsylvania — one of the last remaining entry-level American range manufacturers. Simple, reliable cooking at the lowest prices.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Absolute budget gas range needs. American-made at entry pricing.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Premier:

• American-made in Reading, PA

• Entry-level gas ranges

• Simple, reliable cooking

• Lowest-price American-made range

• Available through independent dealers
